title: A Bottle Marked as Void
story: The field team reached the mudflat as the tide returned, though the protocol required water that had rested on the sediment through the low. Priya filled a bottle anyway and labelled it with the minute plus a note that the condition had not been met. A colleague wanted the note removed so the folder would look complete. Priya refused. A tidy file would let a later paper treat a late sample as a true match. They entered the bottle as void and planned a return at the next suitable low. Missing data, she said, was more honest than a tidy lie.

quiz.question: What extra remark went on the bottle's label?
options: A note that the required condition had not been met
A claim that the tide stayed out all day
A signature approving the sample
A statement that the bottle matched the others
quiz.correctAnswer: A note that the required condition had not been met
quiz.explanation: She labelled the bottle with a note that the condition had not been met.
quiz.supportingSentence: Priya filled a bottle anyway and labelled it with the minute plus a note that the condition had not been met.

quiz.question: How did the team record that bottle?
options: As void, with a return planned for a proper low
As the best sample of the week
As a copy of an older bottle
As a figure ready for the paper
quiz.correctAnswer: As void, with a return planned for a proper low
quiz.explanation: They entered the bottle as void and planned a return at the next suitable low.
quiz.supportingSentence: They entered the bottle as void and planned a return at the next suitable low.

quiz.question: What future mistake is Priya trying to prevent?
options: A paper treating a late sample as if it matched the rules
The closure of the mudflat to every team
The folder deleting the whole study
The tide failing to return the next week
quiz.correctAnswer: A paper treating a late sample as if it matched the rules
quiz.explanation: She fears a later paper would lean on a late sample as though it were a true match.
quiz.supportingSentence: A tidy file would let a later paper treat a late sample as a true match.

quiz.question: What does protocol refer to in this fieldwork?
options: The rules for how a sample must be taken
The name of the shared folder
A boat used to cross the flat
The minute written on the label
quiz.correctAnswer: The rules for how a sample must be taken
quiz.explanation: The protocol is the required way of taking the sample, which this bottle missed.
quiz.supportingSentence: The field team reached the mudflat as the tide returned, though the protocol required water that had rested on the sediment through the low.

quiz.question: Why bring in a colleague who wants the note deleted?
options: To show the pressure to make the set look complete
To reveal that the colleague took the sample alone
To prove the tide never reached the flat
To explain how glass bottles are made
quiz.correctAnswer: To show the pressure to make the set look complete
quiz.explanation: The colleague supplies the temptation to hide the failed condition for the sake of a complete-looking folder.
quiz.supportingSentence: A colleague wanted the note removed so the folder would look complete.
